label: Kazandibi
note: Caramelised milk pudding: traditionally made by burning the bottom of tavuk göğsü; a variant uses muhallebi; name = bottom of the cauldron

about.text: A Turkish dessert, a milk pudding whose bottom is caramelised in the pan, from the Ottoman palace kitchens.
